core_obligations: Apply the special direct system construction to the class of flat modules (proof lines 14388-14392).
Record that each complex in the system is a bounded above complex of flat modules, hence K-flat (proof lines 14393-14396).
Note that the induced map from the colimit to the given complex is a quasi-isomorphism and termwise surjective (proof lines 14397-14399).
Show the colimit is K-flat and that its terms are flat (proof lines 14400-14413).
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs, for any complex of modules over a ring, a K-flat resolution whose terms are flat and whose map to the complex is termwise surjective. The proof applies the standard construction of a special direct system of truncated complexes approximating the given complex: the approximating complexes are bounded above complexes of flat modules by the listed properties, hence K-flat, and the map from their colimit to the given complex is a quasi-isomorphism and termwise surjective by construction. The colimit stays K-flat by the compatibility of K-flatness with filtered colimits, and its terms are flat because filtered colimits of flat modules are flat.
